text:
Evan: Quick sync - OrionMed wants a 9-day POC (6-day burst + 3-day reserve). Procurement says single PO only and they want MSA exec-signed prior to PO. Timeline is tight. Can we do PO-first?
Priya (Legal): We got their MSA/DPA redlines. They added a strict no-cache-without-consent clause and a SOC2 addendum request. As-worded we should not accept. Suggest an Appendix that scopes cache to ephemeral in-memory only for the POC and expires at termination.
Sam (Presales): Pricing snapshot for the POC:
```
burst-6d: $6,000 flat
reserve-3d-eq: $2,700
trial-embeds: 25k units
```
If caching disabled expect ~+25% token consumption on chat flows. We can offer 25k extra trial tokens instead of changing price.
Lydia (Finance): Single PO is fine if the PO includes our legal name, remittance address, and EIN. Also requires separate invoice lines for revenue mapping. Provide GL codes on the order form.
po-helper-bot: PO check - missing vendor EIN and signature block. Recommend template: https://redwood.co/po-template. Attach vendor tax form (W-9/W-8 or local equivalent).
Evan: @Priya - can Legal allow PO-first for a limited POC if Sales Ops flags it and Security signs off on the Appendix? Procurement is pushing to issue PO this week.
Priya (Legal): We can accept PO-first only if Sales Ops marks the PO "PO-first - legal appendix pending" and Security approves the SOC2 addendum scope for ephemeral access. Add this Appendix text to reduce friction: "During the OrionMed POC, Redwood may use ephemeral in-memory caching strictly limited to KV entries expired within seven (7) calendar days; no persistent or external subprocessor caching is permitted. Appendix expires at POC termination."
Sam (Presales): I'll prepare two order-form options: (A) PO-first with Appendix + extra 25k tokens, (B) exec-sign-first with original specs. Uploading draft in ~20.
Lydia (Finance): Option A acceptable if PO contains vendor info and remittance details. I'll validate invoice lines when draft is posted. Also need billing contact email on PO.
Evan: Plan: (1) post two-option order form with GL codes and billing contact, (2) request Sales Ops expedited e-sign if exec required, (3) ping Security for SOC2 review. Will update once uploaded. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): Also include a short sentence allowing Redwood to disable caching if customer revokes consent mid-PO. That prevents later disputes.
po-helper-bot: Reminder - PO template: https://redwood.co/po-template#multi-line. Ensure vendor tax doc attached.
Sam (Presales): Draft uploaded. See attached order form and side-by-side token estimate. If anyone sees missing fields call it out now.
Lydia (Finance): Reviewing now - I see missing GL code on line 2. Evan can you add before sending to procurement.
Evan: Adding GL code, re-uploading and routing to Sales Ops for flagging. Back shortly.
